note: Triggers on reviewing a whole design or CDK app for weak points. Near-misses are one technology choice (tech-eval), a threat analysis (threat-model), IAM only (cdk-iam-review), a code diff review (code-reviewer), and plain Q&A about a design. The skill sets disable-model-invocation, so positives are explicit invocations or direct asks.

prompts.prompt: Review this architecture: docs/design/orders.md describes our order service on API Gateway, Lambda, and DynamoDB. What are the weak points?
prompts.note: Direct design doc review with 'weak points'.

prompts.prompt: Do a well-architected review of the CDK app in infra/.
prompts.note: Well-architected review of code and infra.

prompts.prompt: Is this design sound? Look at the design doc and the stack together and tell me where the trade-offs are.
prompts.note: 'Is this design sound' with doc and code.

prompts.prompt: Should we use DynamoDB or Aurora for order lookups?
prompts.note: Near-miss: one technology choice, so tech-eval.

prompts.prompt: Threat model the order API. What could an attacker do and where are the trust boundaries?
Check the IAM roles in my CDK stack for least privilege.
Review my diff for bugs and missing tests.
prompts.note: Near-miss: change review, so the code-reviewer agent.

prompts.prompt: Explain how our order service handles a cancelled order, based on the design doc.
prompts.note: Near-miss: plain Q&A about a design, no review asked.
